services.name: Sunday Funday Cruise
services.desc: Gorgeous Views, Music and Cold Drinks from our full service bar on the water! Where else would you want to be on a Sunday afternoon? 2 Hours About Join us on the Dora Queen to get your Sunday Funday started off right! Enjoy a cold drink or cocktail while listening to Music and cruising on beautiful Lake Dora. Come aboard, sit back, relax and take in the stunning views with your favorite cold beverage on this 2 hour leisure/entertainment cruise. A Full Service Liquor Beverage Bar is available for guests aged 21+ with a valid photo ID. Guests are welcome to enjoy the breeze on the 2 hours - $45 (plus tax) Adults and Children

services.name: Saturday Cruises
services.desc: Gorgeous Sunset views of Lake Dora aboard the majestic Dora Queen! 2 Hours About We invite you to come aboard, sit back, relax with your favorite cold beverage, listen to some excellent music and enjoy the beautiful views on this 2 hour leisure/entertainment cruise. A Full Service Liquor Beverage Bar is available for guests aged 21+ with a valid photo ID. Guests are welcome to enjoy the breeze on the upper deck or sit comfortably in the lower level temperature controlled salon. Both levels showcase spectacular views of Lake Dora. Guests are free to move around The Queen during their 2 hours - $48 (plus tax) Adults & Children

services.name: Queen's Brunch Aboard the Dora Queen Oct 11th
services.desc: It’s a day to appreciate all Dads. Give the dads in your life the gift of great memories and a little relaxation aboard the majestic Dora Queen on our special Father’s Day cruise. We will depart the dock at 12:30 PM on Sunday, June 21st, 2026 for this 2-hour cruise on scenic Lake Dora. Guests may begin boarding at 12:00 PM. Enjoy excellent live music by Dale New on our open-air (under roof) upper deck, or take in the beautiful lake views through the picture windows on our indoor, climate-controlled lower deck, all while sipping your favorite cocktails. Our full-service beverage bar will be October 11th, $59.95 Plus Tax Per Person Brunch Included

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Host your special event aboard the Dora Queen Please note there is a 6 week advanced booking minimum for private events. Please email info@doraqueen.com so that we can discuss your event! About The Dora Queen offers a unique setting for your event or party for up to 70 of your closest friends. We have plenty of room for live music and dancing. The upper and lower levels present beautiful scenic views for all guests. Let us help make your birthday party, anniversary, wedding, office party or any special occasion extra special by hosting it aboard the Dora Please call 352-533-3380 or email info@doraqueen.com to check availability.
